title: LowMC Security in Related-Key and Keyless Settings
summary: Security is not claimed for LowMC or its variants under related-key attacks or in the listed keyless hash constructions; determine their security in these settings.

formal_statement.body: Determine the security of $\mathrm{LowMC}$ and its variants in use cases for which security is not claimed: against related-key attacks and in keyless constructions, including block-cipher-based compression functions or hash functions and sponge-based hash functions.

scope.domain: Security analysis of the LowMC block cipher and its variants in related-key and keyless construction settings.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine their security against related-key attacks and in block-cipher-based compression or hash functions and sponge-based hash functions.

progress.summary: The paper explicitly lists these uses among its open questions and states that it makes no security claim for them. Security in the related-key and keyless-construction settings remains to be determined.
citation_labels: Martin R. Albrecht et al., Ciphers for MPC and FHE
